manifest.name: hex-view
manifest.title: HexView
manifest.description: Bytes as a hex dump: an offset column, the bytes in hex and as ASCII, virtualized, with keyboard selection and copy as hex or as text.
manifest.usage: Use HexView to show binary payloads exactly: a message's raw key or value, a file's first bytes, a protocol frame. Set the height with className (it scrolls inside). Arrows move the active byte, Shift extends the selection, Ctrl+A selects everything, Ctrl+C copies the selection as hex and Ctrl+Shift+C as text (UTF-8 when it decodes, else Latin-1 with dots); the footer's buttons do the same, and onCopy reports the text. baseOffset numbers a slice of a larger payload. For decoded values use JsonViewer or CodeBlock; for one short value inline, Code.

props.name: bytes
props.description: The bytes to show; an array of numbers from 0 to 255 is taken too.

props.name: baseOffset
props.description: The offset of the first byte, for the offset column.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after a copy (keyboard or footer) with the copied text; the text also goes to the clipboard when the page may write it.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Rows rendered beyond the viewport on each side.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own; set the height here.

slots.name: grid
slots.description: role="grid", the scroll container and the one tab stop; data-slot="hex-view-grid".

slots.name: row
slots.description: role="row" of size.control.xs: the offset (rowheader), the bytes and the ASCII; data-slot="hex-view-row".

slots.name: byte
slots.description: role="gridcell", one byte in hex; data-slot="hex-view-byte", data-selected, data-active.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The selection's size and offset and the copy buttons; data-slot="hex-view-footer".

states.name: selected
states.description: Bytes in the selection, and their ASCII: editor.selection.

states.name: active
states.description: The byte the keyboard is on: a ring while the grid has keyboard focus.

states.name: non-printable
states.description: An ASCII column dot for a byte outside 0x20 to 0x7e, in editor.gutter.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the grid: Fluent's double ring (focusRing).

accessibility: The bytes are an ARIA grid (role="grid", aria-readonly, aria-multiselectable) with one tab stop; the active byte is aria-activedescendant and is always rendered, even while scrolled away.
Each byte cell is labelled with its offset and value ("1f: 6c"); each row has its offset as rowheader and its ASCII as one cell labelled "text: …".
The footer announces the selection (aria-live="polite") and its copy buttons are ordinary buttons.
Focus shows the double ring on the grid and a ring on the active byte: ring.width in color.ring.
